description: This file contains the implementation of the UserRepository class, which interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to User entities. It includes methods for retrieving users by ID, username, email, adding new users, and saving changes to the database.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Implements user data access methods using Entity Framework Core, adhering to the IUserRepository interface.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByUsernameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username asynchronously, case-insensitive.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email address asynchronously, case-insensitive.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new user to the database asynchronously.

methods.name: SaveChangesAsync
methods.description: Commits all pending changes to the database asynchronously and returns true if successful.
